data.ruling: The refutation stands. Most of the figure holds, but its closing sentence does not. The parts that hold: the T4 figures of 370 µs and 988 µs rest on the V186 derivation that T4/015-adjudicator-R9 refuted, and they do not stand. The MAX14921 samples all cells at once, but its VP range is +6 to +65 V, below the 67.2 V of F15. The BQ79616 measures its inputs round robin on one Main ADC (analog-to-digital converter), and it needs at least 6 cells. The part that fails: the closing claim "No part that reads 1 to 16 cells and passes rule 4 samples every cell at once" is not supported. The ADBMS6832MWCCSZ-RL (C18168954) passes rule 4 at a gate of 50. The gate is 5 boards (S7) × 1 placement × 5 (S4), which gives 25, raised to the floor of 50. It has 6097 in stock and a presale count of 6096. Its maker, Analog Devices, is on the S1 list. Its data sheet says all cells are measured simultaneously. Neither its 2-page short-form data sheet (Rev. SpC) nor its product page gives a lowest cell count. It can also run from an isolated supply. So nothing read shows that it fails to read 1 to 16 cells. The sentence has to be weakened to "no part shown to read 1 to 16 cells samples every cell at once", with the ADBMS6832's lowest cell count recorded as not read (not published in the short form). This ruling does not select or clear the ADBMS6832 for R9. Its lifecycle, V181 (lowest cell count) and the other requirement values were not re-read here. Scope is function: the defect is in this figure's claim against V181 and V186, not in any part's lifecycle, allowlist or LCSC identity.
data.evidence: ADBMS6832/ADBMS6833 data sheet Rev. SpC, p. 1 of 2. Features: "Measures up to 18 (ADBMS6832) or 16 (ADBMS6833) battery cells in series" and "Simultaneous and continuous measurement of cell voltages". General description: "All cells can be measured simultaneously and redundantly with two individual analog-to-digital converters (ADCs)" and "can be powered from the battery stack or an isolated supply". It gives no minimum cell count, and neither does the product page. The product page URL adbms6832.html redirects to adbms6832m.html, and its text says only "up to 18" and "up to 16". JLCPCB exact match C18168954: part ADBMS6832MWCCSZ-RL, maker label Analog Devices, LFCSP-64-EP (9 × 9 mm), stockCount 6097, canPresaleNumber 6096, componentLibraryType expand. Rule 4 gate: S4 "5 times the need, never under 50" and S7 "5 boards", so max(5 × 5 × 1, 50) = 50. 6097 ≥ 50 and 6096 ≥ 0, so rule 4 passes. Rule 2: S1 lists Analog Devices. The BQ79616 and MAX14921 statements were not re-fetched here. The verifier read them at 03:26:59Z and 03:27:00Z, and they match T4/018-adjudicator-R9-3.json, read 2026-09-28T15:57:48Z/49Z. The refuted V186 derivation is in T4/015-adjudicator-R9.json.
